# `tuple_sketch_estimate_double`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
tuple_sketch_estimate_double(child)
```

Returns the estimated number of unique values
given the binary representation of a Datasketches TupleSketch. The sketch's
summary type must be a double.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `sketch_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.2 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- tuple_sketch_estimate_double, example 1
> SELECT tuple_sketch_estimate_double(tuple_sketch_agg_double(key, summary)) FROM VALUES (1, 1.0D), (1, 2.0D), (2, 3.0D) tab(key, summary);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```
